Athens - Greek Mythology
Athens , the capital of modern Greece, is the city of Attica whose patron goddess was Athena . In myth it was ruled by kings such as Cecrops, Erechtheus and Aegeus, it was the home of Theseus, and it sheltered suppliants who fled other cities. In history it became one of the leading city -states of Greece, a rival of Sparta, Corinth and Thebes.
